chunks: So We seized the unbelievers. How great was the change I wrought in their condition then!
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'How great was the change' refer to in Surah Al-Furqan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *I'tibar* (taking lesson), emphasizing that the 'seizing' refers not only to physical destruction but also to the spiritual awakening of the faithful through observing the fate of the arrogant. The rhetorical question underscores the suddenness of divine retribution, serving as a warning to those who reject the truth despite clear signs.
